//: Module-boundary rules for the project graph, in Nx's depConstraints shape: a project tagged sourceTag may depend (a Cargo path dependency of any kind, or an Nx implicitDependency) only on projects carrying one of onlyDependOnTags. Enforced by tools/check-project-boundaries.mjs (workspace:lint). The contract depends on nothing it serves; the crate never depends on its test or live suites; only the coverage aggregate (type:workspace) may depend on the e2e suite; nothing outside the live tier may depend on a live project.
